erroneous_recent_report_table_values.note: Section 4.1 in RECENT_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md incorrectly transcribed historical test metrics as: PM2.5 MAE=11.23, RMSE=23.36; PM10 MAE=21.05, RMSE=41.09.

explanation: The earlier report draft had preliminary rounded/uncalibrated values placed in Section 4.1. Recomputing from the exact saved metrics and predictions confirms that on the canonical 404,431 historical test sequences: Static Ensemble PM2.5 MAE is 10.3950 (not 11.23) and RMSE is 18.5498 (not 23.36); PM10 MAE is 18.2809 (not 21.05) and RMSE is 31.9708 (not 41.09). Severity-Gated Ensemble achieves PM2.5 MAE 10.3508 and PM10 MAE 18.1369. Thus, historical models beat 1-hour persistence on both pollutants on the historical test split, but faced a 0.74 ug/m3 PM2.5 gap when transferred zero-shot to 2024 data without dynamic weather.
